title: Quotations for Chapter 4 (money, banks and the central bank's balance sheet): the Bank of England on money creation (2014), Cagan's identity (1965), the Federal Reserve's interest on reserves, floor system and ample reserves (2008-2026), the September 2019 repo spike, the H.4.1 balance sheet of 8 October 2026, Fed settlement services, the ECB's 2024 operational framework, the People's Bank of China's monetary policy reports (2011-2026), Smith (1776) on colonial paper money, Knapp's State Theory of Money, and Peru's tax rules and de-dollarization
source: McLeay, Radia and Thomas (2014, Bank of England); Cagan (1965, NBER); Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the FOMC (2008-2026); Anbil, Anderson and Senyuz (2020, FEDS Notes); Federal Reserve Financial Services; European Central Bank (2024); 中国人民银行货币政策分析小组 (2012-2026); Adam Smith (1776); G. F. Knapp (1905; English translation 1924); Decreto Supremo Nº 151-2002-EF (Peru); Minaya, Lupú and Cabello (2017, BIS); BCRPData
series: id, dynasty (country), year, year_note, value (numbers in the quotation, ';'-separated), unit, numeral (unused), file (key of 'sources'), juan (location in the document), quote (verbatim, or a transcription for image rows), note
license: Quotations for criticism and teaching. Federal Reserve Board, FOMC and H.4.1 documents are works of the US government; Smith (1776) and the 1924 translation of Knapp are quoted from public-domain scans; the Peruvian decree is an official legal text; BCRPData allows reproduction 'siempre y cuando se cite la fuente'. The Bank of England article, Cagan's chapter (NBER), the FEDS Note, the Federal Reserve Financial Services pages, the ECB press release (the ECB permits reproduction with the source acknowledged), the BIS working paper ('Brief excerpts may be reproduced or translated provided the source is stated') and the People's Bank of China reports are quoted briefly with attribution.
fetch: data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py checks every row whose source is not an image
notes: The row with file cagan1965img was read on the page image (the text layer garbles the fractions); its quote column is a transcription. Values are the numbers the text uses, in the order they appear. The H.4.1 rows quote the release's table cells as the verifier sees them after removing the HTML tags (row label, footnote number and the week's changes).
